selection: All eligible recent storms plus evenly spaced historical storms in chronological order; no forecast errors used
daily_rule: Earliest eligible issue per storm per UTC day, with exact -48h through issue analyses and complete +6..+120h route truth
aggregation: Mean across 20 leads within each daily issue; mean of daily scores within each storm; equal-weight mean of storm scores

1.2.policy: Smooth history perturbations; seed=2043+source_row*100+member_id; fixed amplitudes .025 basin and .015 regional

1.1.policy: Public causal route builder and weighted route; correct absolute-to-local projection

evaluation_label: Broader development benchmark. Excludes 1.2 fitting/validation years; not certified untouched for all historical model versions.
